name: Chad1000x

origin.summary: Honors Navy SEAL Chad Wilkinson, who died by suicide on October 29, 2018, after multiple deployments and traumatic brain injuries. One thousand box step-ups with a 45-lb ruck, created by his wife Sara to raise awareness of veteran suicide — completed by thousands each Veterans Day as the CHAD1000X event.

description: 1,000 weighted box step-ups performed wearing a ruck — a single-movement volume test with no other movements involved.
source_notes: crossfit.com/benchmark/chad1000x (official CrossFit Hero WOD page), retrieved 2026-07-09
